campaign.title: Map and attack the M1 spatial-character frequency diagram

conductor_policy.monitoring: Keep the actual Vaaler coefficient and spatial chi_4(d); distinguish direct, transformed, and literature-imported estimates; verify every exponent region and endpoint.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close only after a complete justified M1 phase diagram, a terminal/top verdict, and a primary-source applicability audit exist.

numerical_purpose: falsify an exponent inequality or exact resonance claim
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Numerics cannot certify an asymptotic estimate.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Search primary sources for character-twisted reciprocal sums or applicable exponent-pair theorems and audit every hypothesis.

frozen_target.block: B_1(D,L;X)=sum_(h asymp L) Phi(h/(H_D+1))/h sum_(d asymp D) chi_4(d)w_D(d)e(hX/d), up to the fixed harmless M1 constant and conjugate frequency.
frozen_target.question: Prove B_1(D,L;X)<<_epsilon X^(1/4+epsilon) on the largest possible certified region, decide the terminal/top blocks, and isolate the smallest residual corridor.
frozen_target.success: Prove M9-M1 uniformly, or enlarge its proved region and produce an exact residual corridor with a rigorously scoped next kernel.

exit_gates: exact normalization and exponent phase diagram
campaign.promotion_policy: Promote only rigorously proved regions or exact reductions. A theorem for arbitrary coefficients, an unsigned model, or a smooth full-line endpoint does not imply the actual M1 block.
